patterns: Jensen Huang / Nvidia was the day's biggest story line: 13 hits (~779k views) at a 1.9% like rate. rawsalerts' report of another alleged Huang affair topped the watchlist's news posts at ~403k (1.2%). Follow-ups were about his reported exit and Elon saying hiring him 'would be an honor' (Gunther ~90k at 6.3%, rawsalerts ~47k). alx ran short one-liners on it ('New 𝕏 CEO Jensen?' ~26k, 'Jensen x Elon crossover incoming?' ~14k)

Gunther's 'Hey @grok' questions got the most raw reach again but almost no likes: 7 hits (~880k) at 0.3%. The 'most miles on one car with the original engine' question was the #1 post at ~540k (0.2%), and 'which Bible story has the most archaeological evidence' got ~165k. The '@grok, should Elon hire Huang' crossover got ~61k at 1.3%

Faith-vs-Islam posts had the best mix of reach and likes: 'Teach your kids, there is only one GOD' got ~211k at 9.5%, and the Muslim clothing-store 'reality check' got ~52k at 11.2%. The bucket as a whole: 9 hits (~337k) at 8.3%

House Democrats' coming subpoena power (Robert Garcia's 'hit list' on CNN, Jim Jordan's 'lawfare playbook', Maddow): 17 hits (~701k) at only 2.5%. The Garcia hit-list clip got ~180k (2.2%) and the Kaitlan Collins subpoena exchange ~109k
Veterans Day carryover: 11 hits (~352k) at 6.7%. Trump's Arlington close 'NEVER LET IT FALL' had the day's top like rate at 15.2% (~52k), and 'ABOUT TIME' at Arlington got 13.7% (~50k)

Ilhan Omar posts kept high like rates: 6 hits (~232k) at 8.6%. 'I'll start believing in law and order again when Ilhan Omar is perp walked.' got ~73k at 11.8%. Thune posts (Andy Harris 'SUCK IT UP' ~85k at 9.7%) were still at 7.0% overall

Post-election results (Mississippi flips to Colom ~166k at 0.8%, Texas maps ~106k at 6.5%, Hinojosa price controls ~78k) and breaking disasters (Brooklyn collapse, D.C. gym shooting) got reach at low 1-2.5% like rates
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, ~25 unique posts) was still all about the model race between Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon and GPT-6 Astra. The biggest was @PawelHuryn's bug-hunt benchmark (~32k views), where Gemini 4 Carbon holds #2 and #3 behind Fable 5.2 max. @testingcatalog's daily brief (~31k) forecast Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Flash) and GPT-6.2 Sol/Astra this week, and @StatsWire posted leaked Gemini 4 Hydrogen pricing (~14k). A 'Hey @Grok, which model is best' poll (~16k) and several head-to-head comparisons (~5-10k) filled out the rest. Anthropic's IPO price range ($70-78) appeared in recap threads (~7k). No outsider AI post came close to the watchlist's reach. X News themes: OpenAI on smarter models being harder to monitor, Anthropic curbing Chinese distillation, persistent AI agents now 45% of SemiAnalysis' AI spend, superintelligence-in-2027 debates, and AI overreliance in tech interviews. The closest AI-adjacent watchlist story was the Jensen Huang / Nvidia saga (~779k across 13 hits).
narrative_synthesis: Wednesday-to-Thursday window: the Jensen Huang / Nvidia saga (affair report, reported exit, Elon's 'honor' reply) was the biggest news story line with ~779k views, but Gunther's '@grok' original-engine car question was the single top post at ~540k with almost no likes. Faith posts ('only one GOD' ~211k at 9.5%) and Veterans Day Arlington clips (up to 15.2%) had the best like rates. House Democrats' coming subpoena power was the main political thread at a low like rate, and Omar and Thune posts kept strong engagement. Post-election results (Mississippi, Texas) and breaking disasters (Brooklyn collapse, D.C. gym shooting) got reach but few likes. Volume was 177 originals (Gunther 158, alx 17, rawsalerts 2).
